admin.desc: Orchestrate your entire academy from one war room. Manage players, coaches, events, payments and real-time group notifications.

coach.desc: Build champions with a six-pillar evaluation engine, AI position predictor, KPI radar charts and a structured training architecture.

player.desc: Every player owns their journey. Track performance history, receive personalized training, and stay connected with your squad.

ecosystem.title: Built for the Elite Circuit.

admin.title: Admin Command

coach.title: Coach Intelligence
coach.desc: Empowering technical directors with data-driven decision tools and advanced scheduling.

player.title: Player Performance

analytics.title: Precision Analytics.
analytics.desc: Our proprietary KPI engine cross-references physical performance with technical growth. Experience the future of talent identification.

notification.title: Real-Time Notification Engine
notification.desc: Group and subgroup-aware alerts fire the instant an admin creates an event. Coaches and players are notified with context — match name, group, time — without lifting a finger.

aiPredictor.title: AI Position Predictor
aiPredictor.desc: Our ML engine scores 24+ physical and tactical criteria to predict each player's optimal position with confidence rankings. One click updates their official profile.

evaluation.title: 6-Pillar Evaluation System
evaluation.desc: Coaches score players across Technical, Tactical, Physical, Mental, Health, and Academic pillars monthly. Auto-calculated averages and trend lines expose every weakness before it becomes a problem.

hierarchy.title: Hierarchical Squad Architecture
hierarchy.desc: Structure your academy into Groups and Subgroups. Events, notifications, and participants are resolved automatically based on this hierarchy. Zero manual filtering.
